integrity: The accompanying standalone standard-library Python program enumerates all 84 matchings independently of vertex-deletion incidence counting, compares all 861 pair counts, and checks all 32768 gauge-reduced coefficients against direct sums. The package is same-model reviewed only.
scientific_limitations: The signed-spectrum classification is solely for the 28-vertex Coxeter graph, ordinary equally weighted perfect matchings and the unnormalized binary Walsh transform; it is not an infinite-family or arbitrary-weight theorem. An unindexed equivalent signed-dimer calculation remains a priority risk.
title: Universal modulo-eight signed-dimer rigidity for the Coxeter graph
